stem: How do the interactions between the characters develop a theme that maintaining a friendship requires a willingness to forgive each other's faults?

options.label: A
options.text: By suggesting that Maura and Jorge are closer friends with each other than with others in the group

options.label: B
options.text: By illustrating that Maura and Jorge have experience resolving conflicts

options.label: C
options.text: By having Robert and Belinda each seek out the other to apologize

options.label: D
options.text: By showing how Robert and Belinda accidentally cause each other difficulty through their actions
